explanation: Silver chloride decomposes into silver metal and chlorine gas when exposed to sunlight, the same light-driven reaction black-and-white photography relies on.

beaker_view.final_appearance: The solid darkens to grey, then black, where it's been exposed to light.
beaker_view.observation: Left out in sunlight, the white solid gradually darkens to grey and then black as it decomposes — the same light-driven darkening black-and-white photographic film relies on.
